title: Java method-region NLOCF should treat lambda-local returns as local
wanted_capability: When a candidate extraction range fully contains a lambda expression, returns inside that lambda should not count as non-local control flow crossing the extraction boundary. The region report should distinguish enclosing-method exits from lambda-local returns, or provide a clearly named safe override.
missing_primitive: lambda-aware non-local-control-flow classification for Java methodRegions/extract gates
fallback_used: Probe narrowed extraction to a smaller listener-only block that avoided validator lambdas instead of extracting the broader stage.
